notes.title: V1.6.4.1 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where, in certain cases, the castle could not accumulate damage after exiting Endless Mode and then continuing the game.

Mods Issues
Recently, we received feedback from some players regarding abnormal issues with Mods. Upon investigation, we confirmed that there are indeed some problems with the Mods plugin. As a result, we plan to temporarily remove the Mods feature. We appreciate your understanding.

notes.title: 20250102 Updata
notes.content:
Fixes and Optimizations:

 Fixed an issue where the hammer had an abnormal stacking effect on the Priest.
 Fixed a bug in Endless Mode where the Engineer could reduce the castle's health to zero.
 Fixed a mismatch between the Gravedigger's description and its actual effect.
 Fixed an issue where the Infernal counter was not functioning properly.
 Fixed the damage in Endless Mode being excessively high, which caused an integer overflow with experience points.
 Fixed an issue where Poison and Windfury randomly were not saved in the card attributes.
 Fixed an issue where the Slime’s piercing effect did not work.
 Fixed an issue where the Lich used a fixed attack value of 2 instead of its actual attack stat.

notes.title: Creative Workshop + Endless Mode Launch
notes.content:
Creative Workshop is now live!

 In the main game interface, click the Mods option located in the bottom left corner to enter the Creative Workshop interface.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739576/4904f978811c928171b1c4435243852f7d6e88da.png

 Click on the Tutorial in the top-right corner to review the process for creating and testing Mods.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739576/3691c19078e5e007699e6b40ec5afb48423c032c.png

 Mod Range：
Currently only cards and recipes, most of original cards in game can be implmented. More APIs might be provided. Join the Discord channel to discuss：https://discord.gg/3mdkDpurNn


Endless Mode
After destroying the castle, players can now choose to challenge Endless Mode (previously Extra Challenge, now updated to Endless Mode). The damage dealt to the castle will be displayed below the castle.

New Pieces and Adjustments
Added two new pieces: Graveyard and Colorless Crystal, along with their associated recipes.
Minor adjustments were made to the effects of Tri-colored Dust, Plaguebringer, and Necromancer.

Additionally, several known bugs have been fixed.

You're welcome to join our Discord：https://discord.gg/3mdkDpurNn

notes.title: Dog and Goblin, a Luck be a Landlord-style roguelike card game, is now availale!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The full version of Dog and Goblin, a roguelike card-building game with synthesis mechanics inspired by Luck be a Landlord and auto-chess gameplay, is officially released! 
For the first two weeks, enjoy a 10% discount, making it only $7.19. 
Feel free to go to the Steam to purchase or add it to your wishlist. 
If you haven't tried the game yet, you can also download the free demo to experience it before buying!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739576/a1b05f02eced54ee7fbeb24045c402d83295f8b9.jpg

The game currently features 6 characters, each with 6 progressively unlocked difficulty levels, and 7 completely different gameplay rules to choose from. For example, under Great Fortune rules, a thief appears every 8 waves, a king every 13 waves, while enemy numbers increase progressively. Players start with 40 refresh and delete coins, balancing risk and reward, emphasizing strategy and game understanding. This enhances the game's replay value and overall enjoyment.

Future update plans for the game:

 New enemies and new cards
 Four new challenge modes
 Endless mode


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739576/72317e1f355ef23240834c7cdb8f85238d1d4218.jpg

[Game Introduction]
Dog and Goblin is an auto-battler Roguelike deck-building strategy game where you assemble a mixed army to stand against humans. With nearly 150 units across 19 different types, build your ultimate army and conquer their castles!

Welcome to join in our Discord: https://discord.gg/FUZbe3QsbT

notes.title: Demo Update Announcement - 2024/10/24
notes.content:
Update & Optimization

Cards

 Fixed the bug with the effect of "Golden vs. Dragon."
 Updated the descriptions for Engineer, Enemy (Shaman Link), Wolf, and Wolfgang.
 Added an effect when Blademaster’s clones exceed the limit.
 Salt no longer affects other salt effects.
 FungiKing's card copy attack effect is now half of the permanent attack value.
 Wolf Pack's attack power now only comes from cards on the field.
 Fixed the animation speed of Crossbow and Arrow Tower, and the bug when there are too few targets.


UI

 The recipe display for the card itself is always shown as '?'. 
 Card descriptions no longer show the description for itself. 
 Added a '???' description for synthesis cards when the recipe is not unlocked. 
 Cards that cannot be selected in the card gallery are now shown as semi-transparent, with a quantity of 0. 
 Updated race icons.
  Shortened the duration of splash attacks and flying attack animations. Fast animation settings will now affect more animation options, such as enemy skills. 
 You can now delete multiple cards in a row, and manually close the window. 
 Added the shortcut key "Space" to skip the shop. 
 Fixed the issue where deleted coins were not counted in the score. 
 The score UI is now more prominent on the victory screen.


Features 

 Right-clicking now allows cards to be locked, preventing them from being used in synthesis; click again to unlock.

notes.title: Dog and Goblin Playtest Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
“Dog And Goblin” is expect to begin the Playtest on August 23rd at 2:00 AM (PT). Hope you all enjoy it and add it to your wishlist! It would be a great appreciate!

How to Participate in the Playtest:
You can go to Steam and search for “Dog And Goblin” to enter the game’s store page. Click on “Request Access” under the section “Join the Dog And Goblin Playtest” to participate in it.

The Playtest will begin at 2:00 AM (PT) on August 23rd and will last for 1-2 weeks.

Playtest Content:
Approximately 40 cards, various deck-building strategies, 1 character, and 6 difficulty levels. The synthesis system has been revamped, with 30 new recipes added.

And welcome to join the official community!

notes.title: Version 1.2 Big Update is Live!
notes.content:
Enemy Skill System:
20+ enemies have their unique skills! You'd better destroy the fort ASAP, or the king would exile your deck!
Character Pick:
Player can now choose a character from these 5: Cleric, Commander, Recruiter, Sourcerer, Black Magician. They have different play styles and try to make synergy with your cards.
Improvements

 The whole stats system is reworked and balanced. Hopefully you will find the game not too hard or too ez. But still, feel free to come to Discord and tell us the cards you like or not!
 
 Weak build like poison are buffed (poison damage now ignores armor).
  Legendary cards are less important, they still need a good deck to release the full  power
  Try it out in the game!
 Coin UI Remake.
 Some VFX and SFX added.
 Attack Animation timescale reworked so low damage cards attacks faster and high damage cards slower.
 Heartlosing Mechanism reworked: you lose heart only when you have exceeded enemies at the start of a turn.

Bug fixed

 Tutorial display bug fixed.
 Sometimes players cant return to main menu.
